credibility.text: All of our instructors are licensed Physical Therapists, and every program is built on posture analysis, movement assessment, and rehabilitation principles — for rehab, prenatal/postnatal, athletes, and beginners alike.

location.heading: Find Us at Cove Hill
location.sub: 2nd floor, Charoen Krung — easy to reach, easy to find.

faq.q: Do I need any Pilates experience?
faq.a: No experience needed — many clients try Revive as complete beginners. Because every instructor is a licensed physical therapist, your trial starts with a posture and goals assessment so exercises are matched to your body from the start.
Comfortable, stretchy clothing you can move freely in. Grip socks are recommended for reformer work — bring your own or ask us about picking up a pair.

faq.q: Can my trial focus on a specific goal, like rehab or prenatal care?
faq.a: Yes. Let your instructor know your focus — rehabilitation, prenatal/postnatal, sports performance, or general strength and mobility — when you book on LINE, and your session will be tailored around it.
Message us on LINE (@revivepilates) with your preferred day and time, and we'll confirm your trial slot.
